name: How do I know if a layout reconfiguration actually improved the home?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a layout reconfiguration actually improved the home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A successful reconfiguration should improve movement, make rooms more usable, reduce dead space, and better match how you live. In many homes, the best outcome is not simply a bigger room, but a layout that creates clearer transitions, better storage, and more natural use of every area.
acceptedAnswer.description: If the home flows better, uses space more efficiently, and fits your routines more naturally, the reconfiguration worked.
